findings.evidence: cli.py:738-741 runs float(value)/int(value) on per-job temperature/max_tokens with no try/except, and cli.py:756-759 does the same for top-level keys. 'ghostreader config set craft.temperature abc' raises an uncaught ValueError traceback instead of a clean error. Config is not written.
findings.message: ghostreader/cli.py:727–744 — Invalid numeric config input crashes the CLI. Users setting per-job temperature or max_tokens to an invalid number receive an unhandled ValueError instead of a reported configuration error.
